configuration.method_note: AdaptiveMsg-NSMP follows the paper procedure: sampled interfaces, multi-start gradient-based approximate partial minimization, node-specific message regression, validation-based selection among constant/linear/quadratic/MLP representations, root minimization, and downward recovery.
configuration.communication_note: Float32 payload only. AdaptiveMsg-NSMP counts one upward transmission of each selected message state and one downward interface vector per tree edge.
configuration.private_recovery_note: After the downward pass fixes all interfaces, each client's private model is re-optimized from the local-pretraining state for recovery_steps updates; the checkpoint is selected using only that client's validation data.
